# Radigene

> Radigene B.V. is a Dutch company, based in the Leiden area, building the imaging layer for living medicines: a reporter gene on engineered cells and a matching radiolabelled tracer, so that PET and SPECT scans can show where the cells are in the body. The approach has been shown in mice. It is investigational, not used in patients and not a medical device.

## Pages
- [Home](https://radigene.nl/): the problem (we cannot see where cell therapies go), the approach, aims and status
- [Technology](https://radigene.nl/technology.html): reporter tag on the cell, radiolabelled peptide tracer, PET or SPECT scan
- [About](https://radigene.nl/about.html): founders Laura Mezzanotte (CEO) and Cas Kranenburg (business development)
- [Contact](https://radigene.nl/contact.html): hello@radigene.nl

## Facts
- Company: Radigene B.V., KvK 42179941, the Leiden area, the Netherlands
- Founders: Laura Mezzanotte (leads science and operations), Cas Kranenburg (leads IP, partnerships and fundraising)
- Evidence: the underlying approach was published in mice (Gaspar et al., Int. J. Mol. Sci. 2024, doi 10.3390/ijms25158206)
- Status: aims such as comparing therapies, predicting response and designing trials are not yet demonstrated in patients
- Contact: hello@radigene.nl
